description: Grafana v2 example for vault-solver metrics. Uses example scrape labels namespace and pod; adapt selectors, grouping and table fields to your collection setup. Choose a Prometheus-compatible datasource. Counters cover the selected interval; current state uses current samples. Missing data is not a healthy state.

spec.title: CPU usage
spec.description: Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) ((rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__rate_interval])) and on (namespace, pod) solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""})

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod) ((process_resident_memory_bytes{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""} and on (namespace, pod) solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

max by (namespace, pod) ((go_memstats_heap_alloc_bytes{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""} and on (namespace, pod) solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

spec.title: Runtime pressure
spec.description: Process-local concurrency and file descriptor pressure. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod) ((go_goroutines{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""} and on (namespace, pod) solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))
max by (namespace, pod) ((process_open_fds{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""} and on (namespace, pod) solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

spec.title: RPC call counts
spec.description: Logical JSON-RPC calls in the selected range; these are counts, not rates. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: (sum by (namespace, pod, role, method, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_rpc_requests_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range]))) > 0

spec.title: RPC errors: what failed
spec.description: Bounded error classes by method. rpc_error is a returned JSON-RPC error (for example a revert), distinct from transport failure. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: (sum by (namespace, pod, role, method, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_rpc_requests_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!="",outcome!="success"}[$__range]))) > 0

spec.title: Endpoint attempt counts
spec.description: Each endpoint ordinal is local to one pod and role. URLs are deliberately absent from labels. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: (sum by (namespace, pod, role, endpoint, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_rpc_attempts_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range]))) > 0

spec.title: RPC latency
spec.description: End-to-end request latency through response-body consumption. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (namespace, pod, le, role) (rate(solver_bot_rpc_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (namespace, pod, le, role) (rate(solver_bot_rpc_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (namespace, pod, le, role) (rate(solver_bot_rpc_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: RPC in-flight
spec.description: Calls whose response body has not completed. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod, role) (solver_bot_rpc_inflight{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""})

spec.title: RPC success age
spec.description: Age of the last successful logical request by role. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod, role) (clamp_min(time() - solver_bot_rpc_last_successful_request_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}, 0) * (solver_bot_rpc_last_successful_request_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""} > bool 0))

spec.title: Pods
spec.description: Selected active runtime pods.

spec.expr: count(max by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

spec.title: Fallback overhead
spec.description: Selected-range counts. Extra attempts are endpoint attempts beyond logical calls. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_rpc_requests_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range]))
sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_rpc_attempts_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range]))

max by (namespace, pod) (clamp_min(sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_rpc_attempts_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range])) - sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_rpc_requests_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range])), 0))

spec.title: Transaction outcomes
spec.description: Terminal logical transaction counts by operation and outcome. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: ((sum by (namespace, pod, label, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_requests_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range]))) > 0) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (max_over_time(solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range])))

spec.title: Admission and in-flight
spec.description: Current accepted work plus selected-range pre-admission rejections. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: (sum by (namespace, pod, label) (solver_bot_txmanager_inflight{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

((sum by (namespace, pod, label, reason) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_admission_rejections_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range]))) > 0) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

spec.title: Lifecycle latency
spec.description: Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (namespace, pod, le, label) (rate(solver_bot_txmanager_lifecycle_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (namespace, pod, le, label) (rate(solver_bot_txmanager_lifecycle_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

spec.title: Phase latency p95
spec.description: Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (namespace, pod, le, label, phase) (rate(solver_bot_txmanager_phase_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

spec.title: Gas used
spec.description: Receipt gas units in the selected range. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: ((sum by (namespace, pod, label, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_gas_used_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range]))) > 0) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

spec.title: Fees paid
spec.description: Actual receipt gasUsed × effectiveGasPrice, not an estimate. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: ((sum by (namespace, pod, label, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_fee_paid_wei_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range])) / 1e18) > 0) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (max_over_time(solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range])))

spec.title: Replacements and cancellations
spec.description: Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: ((sum by (namespace, pod, label, kind) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_replacements_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range]))) > 0) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

spec.title: Sender balance history
spec.description: Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod, address) ((solver_bot_txmanager_account_balance_wei{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""} / 1e18) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""})))

spec.title: Unready pods
spec.description: Selected runtime pods whose shared readiness gate is closed.

spec.expr: sum(1 - min by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_service_ready{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

spec.title: Sender nonce history
spec.description: Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod, address) ((solver_bot_txmanager_account_latest_nonce{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""})))

max by (namespace, pod, address) ((solver_bot_txmanager_account_pending_nonce{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""})))

spec.title: Account snapshot health
spec.description: Refresh counts and retained snapshot age; failed refreshes do not zero balance or nonce gauges. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: ((sum by (namespace, pod, outcome) (increase(solver_bot_txmanager_account_refreshes_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range]))) > 0) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

max by (namespace, pod, address) ((clamp_min(time() - solver_bot_txmanager_account_last_successful_refresh_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}, 0) * (solver_bot_txmanager_account_last_successful_refresh_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""} > bool 0)) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""})))

spec.title: Solver assignment
spec.description: Config-time solver membership by execution pod and process; this is topology rather than traffic inference. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod, solver) (solver_bot_solver_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""})

spec.title: RPC endpoint health
spec.description: Freshness by execution pod, role, and role-local endpoint ordinal. Never means a configured fallback has not yet been needed successfully. Configured RPC URLs are intentionally never exported. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: max by (namespace, pod, role, endpoint) (clamp_min(time() - (solver_bot_rpc_last_successful_attempt_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""} > 0), 0) or ((solver_bot_rpc_last_successful_attempt_timestamp{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""} == 0) - 1))

spec.title: Pod status
spec.description: One row per selected execution pod/process. Rows remain fixed-size as the fleet grows; the table scrolls instead of shrinking values. Metric drops expose code/spec drift in bounded workflow instrumentation. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: min by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_service_ready{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""})

min by (namespace, pod) (time() - (process_start_time_seconds{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""} and on (namespace, pod) solver_bot_build_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))
max by (namespace, pod) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_balance_wei{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""} / 1e18)

max by (namespace, pod) (clamp_min(solver_bot_txmanager_account_pending_nonce{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""} - solver_bot_txmanager_account_latest_nonce{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}, 0))
max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""})
sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(solver_bot_workflow_dropped_observations_total{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__range]))

spec.title: Configured solvers
spec.description: Solver memberships across the selected runtime pods.

spec.expr: count(max by (namespace, pod, solver) (solver_bot_solver_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

spec.title: Transaction signers
spec.description: Distinct process-scoped transaction-sender identities in the selected fleet.

spec.expr: count(count by (address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

spec.title: Admission wait p95
spec.description: Leading indicator for nonce-lane saturation, split by request label and terminal admission outcome. Values are shown per namespace/pod across matching scrape targets.

spec.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (namespace, pod, le, label, outcome) (rate(solver_bot_txmanager_admission_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}[$__rate_interval])))) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (address) (max by (namespace, pod, address) (solver_bot_txmanager_account_info{namespace="${namespace}",pod=~"${pods}",pod!=""}))

spec.title: RPC by pod and endpoint role

title: Vault Solver · Runtime, RPC & Signers by Pod

spec.name: pods
spec.label: Pods
spec.description: All expands to the pod names discovered for this solver and selected time range.
